why: Verdict rule: "edge" needs OOS n >= 30, OOS net mean > 0 at h=5 and PBO < 0.5; "insufficient n" if OOS n < 30;
otherwise "no edge". Baseline (buy every bar, OOS) mean return is ~0.000% at every horizon and tf.
